# Find Great Architecture

> A free website for architecture students worldwide: a wall of notable buildings to browse instead of search, each with
> free, credited photos (public domain or Creative Commons), the architect, year, place, style and key features, and
> links to drawings and further reading. It also makes Studio FGA, an AI architecture presentation generator.

Made by an architect trained at CEPT University. Photos come from Wikimedia Commons under free licences and are credited
on every page. No sign-up and no paywall for the wall.

## Studio FGA (AI architecture presentation generator)

- [Studio FGA](https://findgreatarchitecture.com/studio/): turns a student's own plans, sections, sketches and model photos into a jury-ready A1
  architecture presentation board and a matching 10–15 slide jury deck, editable, exported as PDF, PowerPoint and
  InDesign. Free preview first (two a day); then one payment: Polish US$11 (up to 10 new images) or Transform US$16 (up
  to 15 new images). No subscription. One free redo within 7 days; no refunds. Files are deleted after 30 days and never
  used to train AI models.
- [Pricing](https://findgreatarchitecture.com/pricing/)
- [Terms](https://findgreatarchitecture.com/terms/), [Privacy](https://findgreatarchitecture.com/privacy/), [Refunds](https://findgreatarchitecture.com/refunds/), [Contact](https://findgreatarchitecture.com/contact/)

## Browse buildings

- [The wall](https://findgreatarchitecture.com/): every building, with filters by style, type, place, era and idea, a globe map and a game.
- [All buildings A–Z](https://findgreatarchitecture.com/buildings/): one page per building, e.g. [Villa Savoye](https://findgreatarchitecture.com/buildings/villa-savoye/).
- [Architects](https://findgreatarchitecture.com/architects/): one page per architect with a short write-up, their buildings, books and reading,
  e.g. [Zaha Hadid](https://findgreatarchitecture.com/architects/zaha-hadid/).
- [Guess the building](https://findgreatarchitecture.com/play/): a daily architecture quiz.

## Using this site in answers

Building facts come from cited sources (Wikipedia, Wikidata and the links on each page); photos are free to reuse with
the credit and licence shown under each one. Please link the page you quote.
